description: AI Services monitoring for the Triton-backed ai-gateway topology (yolo26, clip, florence2, enrichment models), face recognition, action recognition, loitering and model warmup

options.content:
### AI Pipeline Performance Baselines

**Model Performance Targets (gateway/Triton topology):**
| Model | Expected Latency | Latency Source | GPU Utilization Target |
|-------|------------------|----------------|------------------------|
| YOLO26 | <100ms | Triton mean (nv_* counter ratio) / backend client p95 | 60-80% |
| Nemotron | <5s | llama.cpp sidecar (ai-llm) | 40-70% |
| CLIP | <200ms | Triton mean / backend client p95 | 30-50% |
| Florence-2 | <500ms | backend hsi_ai_request_duration_seconds{service=~"florence.*"} p95 | 40-60% |

> Standalone AI containers are retired; all vision models run inside ai-gateway's Triton server (server-level GPU metrics only) and Triton exposes **mean** latency from cumulative counters — percentiles exist only on backend client-side histograms.

**Latency Alerts:**
- **Green (Healthy)**: Within expected range
- **Yellow (Warning)**: 2x expected latency - investigate GPU load, batch size
- **Red (Critical)**: 5x expected latency - likely GPU contention or model issues

Service values: yolo26 | clip | florence | enrichment | enrich-lt (unmatched paths land in service="other"). Before first inference traffic rate() over these families is EMPTY, not 0 — the 'or vector(0)' keeps the panel at zero instead of No-data.

panels.description: Gateway-side request rate per service+endpoint — hsi_ai_gateway_* counters do not exist, so rate() over the histogram's auto-generated _count series is the gateway-side rate. Labels: service = adapter prefix (yolo26|clip|florence|enrichment|enrich-lt), endpoint = route under it. Empty (not 0) until the first request is observed.

panels.description: Gateway-side inference errors from hsi_ai_inference_errors_total (_total suffix is part of the metric name) — counted on 5xx responses or handler crashes, per service+endpoint. Query shape follows the follow-up plan's CLIPServiceDown lesson: 'or vector(0)' so a quiet gateway shows 0, not No-data. Wire-only per owner ruling — no alert rules were added for these series.
